feedback.problem:
| $f$ | $Y=2$ | $Y=4$ | $Y=6$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=1$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ |
| $X=3$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ |

Compute $P(Y=2\,|\,X=3)$ given that the discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ have the joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ shown in the table above.
feedback.worked_solution:
By the multiplication law for conditional probability, the required probability is given by

$$
P(Y=2\,|\,X=3)=\frac{P(X=3,Y=2)}{P(X=3)}=\frac{f(3,2)}{{f}_{X}(3)},
$$

where $f(x,y)$ is the joint probability mass function of $X$ and $Y,$ and ${f}_{X}(x)$ is the marginal distribution of $X.$

Recall that the marginal distribution for $X$ corresponds to the row totals. Thus,

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{X}(3) & =f(3,2)+f(3,4)+f(3,6) \\  & =\frac{1}{8}+\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{8} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

From the given table, we have that $f(3,2)=\frac{1}{8}.$ 

Finally, substituting ${f}_{X}(3)=\frac{1}{2}$ and $f(3,2)=\frac{1}{8}$ in our formula above, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}P(Y=2\,|\,X=3) & =\frac{f(3,2)}{{f}_{X}(3)} \\  & =\frac{(\frac{1}{8})}{(\frac{1}{2})} \\  & =\frac{1}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
